items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And man, and then Shalang and I always got in a fight, see. Shalang, man.

ctx.x: What did you talk to, Benny?

The Jack Lapine, Abbie, had a sweet-tone of the trumpet. And it was playing up there, open-air, see. And the other day, they didn't have them up for the trumpet. Had to put a pillow in. The boy says, I hear you. You get fired. I said, well, with wire brushes. Why brushes? We're just picking the kind of problem at the time, see. Well, that was right down the alley. Because they had guys before my time, they could make a good roll, and I could, see. But I was a little more modern, see. I had to put the socks up. I…
Well, I heard some different stories about him.
